column3: BOJ hikes to 1.00% at June 2026 meeting
column9: Base case per v1.3 update. Mark down 70% → ~57% on 2026-05-25 post April CPI miss. **Further mark down ~57% → ~50% on 2026-05-28: Tokyo May CPI core-core 1.6% (−30bp vs Apr 1.9%; 7th straight monthly decline), breaching the pre-registered 1.9% June-BOJ threshold.** Then a coin-flip. Why only -7pp (not a slash): (1) Tokyo CPI carries structural downward bias vs national from Tokyo-specific subsidies — national May core-core (Jun 19, post-BOJ) likely prints above 1.6%; (2) BOJ normalization bias is wage-driven (Shunto 5.26%), not spot-CPI driven (Ueda: temporary downward pressure won't prevent hikes); (3) counterweights intact: Q1 GDP +2.1%, exports +14.8%, 3-dissent split for 1.00%, Apr SoO "quite possible from next MPM." Against: Takaichi political ceiling; Sato joins June (hawk→dove); subsidies muddy signal; Iran MOU optimism. Threshold-vs-mechanism discipline: Tokyo CPI is a leading-threshold read; the wage-price mechanism is what the BOJ actually reacts to. **2026-05-29: April activity data beat (IP +0.8% MoM vs −0.4% exp; retail sales +2.1% YoY vs +1.4% exp) = hawkish counterweight on the mechanism side; HELD ~50% pending market confirmation.** **2026-05-31 MARK UP ~50% → 70%: market repriced the June hike sharply HIGHER — Polymarket 88.2% / trader-swap pricing ~87.5% (both current May 31), vs our stale 55-65% read (Polymarket was 59.5% on May 22). A SUSTAINED 9-day repricing (~60% → 88%) that held THROUGH two dovish CPI prints — the market is weighting the activity beat + 3-dissent split + SoO "quite possible from next meeting" over the soft CPI, i.e. siding with the wage/activity MECHANISM over the CPI THRESHOLD (vindicates the mechanism-vs-threshold framing). +20pp not the full +38pp to market because: (a) earned discount — failed TWICE too-hawkish on the Takaichi 0.75% ceiling (SAM-08 @90%, SAM-20 @60%), ceiling still live; (b) thin-liquidity caveat on Polymarket. 70% = clear base case, ~30% held for political-ceiling/surprise tail. Verify swap pricing again Jun 9-15.** **2026-06-09 MARK UP 70% → 75%: pre-registered mechanical trigger (Jun 3) FIRED. Polymarket BOJ Jun 16 hike = 98.2% (4th sequential ≥90% read: Tue 87.6 → Wed 94.8 → Thu 96.9 → Fri 96.3 → Tue 98.2; +1.9pp vs Fri; volume $403K up from $304K — continued grind, no retrace). Takaichi/cabinet pushback leg: NONE — Reuters "refrained from vocally pushing back"; Jun 8 Takaichi remarks were FX-side (yen confidence/supply chains), reinforce Jun 3 intervention-permission framing rather than walking back. Q1 GDP revised +1.8% annualized (vs +2.1% prelim, -0.3pp) BUT composition is hike-tolerant — private consumption revised UP (0.35% vs 0.27%), capex revised DOWN (-0.7% vs +0.3%, software/machinery weak); headline-soft mechanism-firm, no material USDJPY reaction (still ~160.1). Discipline-preserving discount vs market widened to 23pp (75 vs 98.2) — calibration not disagreement; failed-twice-too-hawkish Takaichi-ceiling discount retained for the ~25% tail (political surprise, late dovish capitulation, secret YCC-style cap). Multi-source corroboration in cabling window (Bloomberg sources leak Jun 4, Ueda Kisaragi-kai speech Jun 3 explicit hawkish-of-pricing) provided structural overdetermination beyond the Polymarket-only trigger condition.** **2026-06-14 MARK UP 75% → ~90% (CH-009 applied, S4 void-gate clear): pre-blackout consolidated re-mark. Polymarket 99.2% (9th sequential ≥90% read, +1.7pp vs Thu 97.5%, $584K vol = active conviction); swaps 93% (Tokyo Tanshi Jun 9); Bloomberg 49/51 economists for 25bp → 1.00% (Jun-9 piece); Reuters poll 94%. Void-clause check clean: no source-named dovish leak Thu-PM → Sun; swaps >85% threshold. Ueda hospitalization (misses Jun 16 MPM, Himino chairs / Uchida presser) is a HEALTH event, NOT a dovish signal — Reuters Jun 11 "decision largely settled at 1.0%." Discount to Polymarket narrowed to ~9pp; direction unchanged, magnitude moved to reflect S4 void-gate clearing. Residual ~10% = political-Takaichi/secret-YCC tail (~5-7pp) + 2-day binary surprise via Uchida-presser dovish-cover (~3-5pp, Apr-13 Himino precedent). Resolves Jun 16.** **2026-06-16 RESOLVED CONFIRMED (TRUE): BOJ hiked 25bp to 1.00% — highest since 1995. Vote 7-1, Asada dissenting for a HOLD (DOVISH dissent, opposite of the Apr-28 3-hawkish-dissent shape); growth + inflation outlook RAISED; Uchida fronted the presser (Ueda absent, hospitalized), FX comment boilerplate ("watching, don't target"), forward guidance "further hikes not imminent" (ING). This is the MODAL delivered-as-priced package, NOT the hawkish-of-pricing tail. Market reaction confirms CH-004: USDJPY WEAKENED to 160.36 (+0.25%) and FXY flat ($57.22) on a hike to a 31-yr-high rate — fully-priced delivery did not unwind carry (buy-rumor-sell-fact). ~90% mark directionally well-calibrated; the dovish dissent + soft guidance are exactly the residual-~10% texture, but did not block the hike. Calibration: 6th sequential ≥90% read resolved TRUE.**

column3: MOF intervention #3 occurs before June BOJ if USDJPY pushes 159+
column9: Apr 30 + May 6 set precedent; Bessent affirmation May 11-12 removes diplomatic ceiling. Mark down 75% → ~55% on 2026-05-25 — Brent collapsed -12% to $94.53 on Iran/Hormuz MOU optimism, defusing near-term USDJPY upside. **2026-06-01 MARK UP ~55% → ~72%: Iran MOU effectively broken — Tasnim reported Tehran suspended message exchange via mediators + threatened to "completely block" Hormuz; Brent +4.02% to $94.78, WTI +7%. Pakistan-mediated 60-day framework hit hard setback (not formal collapse but document exchange halted; fresh US-Iran clashes near Hormuz). USDJPY 159.64 back inside 159.50+ trigger zone. Katayama (May 29) "decisive action against volatility or speculative movement" verbal at 159.3+ frames live MOF posture; Bessent-Katayama-Himino alignment cabling hike + intervention combo per Reuters Jun 1. The explicit re-rate-higher condition from the May 25 mark-down (MOU collapse + USDJPY 160 retest) is now substantially met — held below 75% only because USDJPY hasn't tagged 160 yet (160 is the hard intervention trigger). Pre-meeting blackout starts ~Jun 13.** **2026-06-14 MARKED DOWN ~72% → ~30% (CH-011): disorder-not-level falsified empirically — 6+ orderly sessions at 160+ with NO 3rd strike; de-escalation removed the oil→yen-weak forcing.** **2026-06-16 RESOLVED FALSE: USDJPY pushed and held 159+ (closed 160+ for 8+ orderly sessions through the meeting, 160.36 on BOJ day) but NO 3rd MOF intervention occurred before/through the June BOJ meeting. The conditional's trigger (159+) fired; the intervention did not. CALIBRATION WIN: we marked DOWN from 72% → ~30% pre-event on the CH-011 disorder-not-level mechanism read, which resolved correct — the FAIL was anticipated, not a surprise. Reinforces [[finding_threshold_vs_mechanism]]: MOF #3 fires on DISORDER (gap speed / range), not on level proximity. Re-anchoring CHANGELOG entry queued post-BOJ.**
